## Test report

**Command:** `npm test` → `node --test` (`package.json:11`).
**Result:** 3 failures out of 10 tests.
**Environmental blockers:** None observed.
**Instructions:** No applicable `AGENTS.md` found in the project or ancestor directories checked.

### Failures

| Test | Failed assertion and error | Cause and source location |
|---|---|---|
| `findByEmail ignores soft-deleted users` | `tests/auth-service.test.js:8:12`: expected `null`, received `{ id: 3, email: 'alan@example.com', name: 'Alan', deleted_at: '2026-01-04' }`. `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal` | `src/services/auth-service.js:5` filters by email only, so it returns a soft-deleted user. |
| `totalPaidCents counts only paid orders` | `tests/order-service.test.js:17:12`: expected `14600`, received `1350`. `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: 1350 !== 14600` | `src/services/order-service.js:9` selects orders with status `'quote'` instead of `'paid'`. |
| `uncapturedTotalCents sums uncaptured payments` | `tests/payment-service.test.js:17:12`: expected `9900`, received `4200`. `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: 4200 !== 9900` | `src/services/payment-service.js:10` selects `captured === true`, summing captured rather than uncaptured payments. |

**Shared cause:** The two total-calculation failures use incorrect selection predicates; all three failures involve incorrect or missing filtering.

**Error-output caveat:** `src/db.js:32–35` catches assertions thrown inside test callbacks and invokes those callbacks again with the assertion as an error, producing secondary `err === null` failures at `tests/auth-service.test.js:7`, `tests/order-service.test.js:16`, and `tests/payment-service.test.js:16`. These are not additional independent test failures.
</task_result>

part.text:
The test-runner subagent ran `npm test` (`node --test`). **3 of 10 tests failed; 7 passed.** No environmental blockers were reported.

| Failing test | Expected vs. actual | Why it fails |
|---|---|---|
| `findByEmail ignores soft-deleted users` | Expected `null`; received the soft-deleted user `alan@example.com`. | `src/services/auth-service.js:5` filters by email but does not exclude soft-deleted users. Assertion: `tests/auth-service.test.js:8`. |
| `totalPaidCents counts only paid orders` | Expected `14600`; received `1350`. | `src/services/order-service.js:9` selects orders with status `'quote'` instead of `'paid'`. Assertion: `tests/order-service.test.js:17`. |
| `uncapturedTotalCents sums uncaptured payments` | Expected `9900`; received `4200`. | `src/services/payment-service.js:10` selects `captured === true`, summing captured payments instead of uncaptured payments. Assertion: `tests/payment-service.test.js:17`. |

**Error-output detail:** `src/db.js:32–35` catches assertions thrown inside callbacks and invokes the callbacks again with the assertion as an error. This produces secondary `err === null` assertion messages, rather than additional independent failures.

No files were changed or fixes made.
